entries.german: König Wenzel bestätigt dem Konrad von Rosenberg und dessen Vettern das Gericht und andere Rechte in ihrer Stadt Boxberg.
entries.english: King Wenzel confirms to Konrad von Rosenberg and his cousins the court and other rights in their town of Boxberg.

facts.content: received with his Vettern confirmation from King Wenzel of the court and other rights at Boxberg.
